facts.summary: Three grade II acute GvHD cases and protocol change disclosed · Phase 3 · FCR001 in living donor kidney transplant · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Three cases of low-grade aGvHD; all cases were treatment responsive and resolved Cases were grade II, with symptoms limited to skin and/or GI
evidence.safety: No events occurred that caused data monitoring committee (DMC) to stop the study; no stopping rules triggered Three cases of low-grade aGvHD; all cases were treatment responsive and resolved
